about: What Shree-Lipi's own composers write for Unicode Telugu: S8TelU64.dll (Unicode) and S8Tel764.dll (Shree-Lipi 7 raw bytes), Shree-Lipi nxt, typed the same keys into both (capture r3\cap-tel, 2026-10-18: the 16 vendor .TEL keyboards and 878 probe keyboards, every capture run twice in separate processes, byte-identical). Each row: the Unicode string, the preferred bytes (hex, one byte per glyph code; 80-9F as the fonts map them, Windows-1252) and, when there are any, the other spellings the composer also accepts. Canonical typing order only (the consonant, then the vowel sign, then ం ః ఁ; conjuncts with the link code; the ra-vattu struck before its letter, as the vendor charts type it); the other orders and the composer's quirks are kept in the capture, not here. A row with five fields is a documented exception: the table writes the preferred bytes, the composer wrote the fourth field (accepted, read back), the fifth says why (see "exceptions"). word-final rows (C + virama at the end of a word) come from tools/Shared/ShreeWordFinal.cs: the composer's own spelling of C + virama + ZWNJ (its pending link drops the virama). The same bytes serve every face: SHREE-TEL7-* and SHREE-TEL-* (identical designs), Shree-Tel7-001/002. tools/TelTruth builds and checks the shree-tel7 / shree-tel7w tables against it.

exceptions.nga-vattu: ్ఙ: the composer writes 5D, which every installed face draws as the visarga (two circles, advance 198/1000); the subjoined ఙ is 94 (the code the 7 composer types for its own code DB). The table writes 94.
exceptions.rra-vattu: ్ఱ: the composer writes CA, a spacing glyph (advance 752/1000) with the outline of the ు+ూ tail: క్ఱ = 4D E6 FC CA is drawn as కూ, BA CA as ౠ (the earlier table spelled ౠ so). The subjoined ఱ is 3C (zero width like every vattu; 4D E6 FC 3C draws what Nirmala UI draws for క్ఱ - r3\tbl-tel\round1\gdi-rra.png, eye-v.png; the earlier table wrote 3C). The table writes 3C. (The 7 composer types 3C for its code 5E after the link - క్ష subjoined, 7-only evidence - which draws ్ఱ: the table writes C్క్ష as the vattus of క and ష, 50 DB.)
exceptions.visarga: ః: the composer writes 40, which every installed face draws as a talakattu tick (zero width, advance 5/1000, the same ink as E6); the visarga glyph is 5D. The table writes 5D (cap-tel fonts\check-marks3.png, gdi-marks.png).
exceptions.candrabindu: ఁ: the composer writes B6, which every installed face draws as a talakattu tick (in SHREE-TEL7-Apoorva B6 is the very outline of E6); the candrabindu glyph is 97. The table writes 97.
exceptions.jha-dropped: C్ఝ: the composer writes nothing for ఝ after the link (no face has a subjoined ఝ): the letter is lost. The table writes the visible halant of the letter before it and ఝ in full - its own spellings of C్‌ and ఝ..., both truth rows.
exceptions.removed: Rows left out of the table's truth: ౢ (the composer writes AB A7 E6, pieces of ధ - no face has a vocalic-l glyph: passed through, reported, P3b); * (92, which draws ₹ in SHREE-TEL7/SHREE-TEL and a star in Shree-Tel7-001/002: per family, Family.cs); — and – (9B 9B / 9B: 9B is a blank glyph, advance 269/1000, in every face - Word shows a gap; written as the fonts' hyphen 26, P4); శ్రీ్‌క (a virama after a vowel sign: not well-formed text).

removed: per family (92 draws ₹ or a star)
no vocalic-l glyph: the composer writes pieces of ధ
